label: Solution chemistry
description: The chemistry step: every compound with its starting concentration or amount and its measured yield or concentration, stock solutions, molar ratios; calculations turn amounts and stocks into concentrations and name the water type.

pack_parameters.description: total volume of the reaction solution (liquid) the compounds were in: as stated, or -- when the paper gives only the volumes of the solutions combined -- their sum, with b 'derived' and the parts in `n`.
the solvent. For water, the type exactly as stated: distilled, deionized (DI), Milli-Q, ultrapure, nanopure, tap -- just 'water' if the paper doesn't say.

stage_rules: Dissolved compounds and their concentrations or yields are recorded by the chemistry step -- don't list them here.

variable_categories.label: Starting Compounds
variable_categories.description: concentrations of the compounds in the starting solution

variable_categories.label: Products
variable_categories.description: amounts and yields of the compounds formed or measured at the end

fixed.solvent_volume_mL: the amounts calculation reads the reaction volume in mL
